Hard evidence already established: M5 300-ft skidpad 0.986 g; strict validation 0 FAIL; tire pure-slip post-peak retention ~90% at 15 deg and ~80% at 20 deg; combined slip, AWD torque split, load sensitivity, track asphalt mapping, camber/contact signs and rear-steer phase are not currently proven defects. Mobile wheel is now 900 deg lock-to-lock default and ordinary 60 deg hand input stays below 8 deg peak front slip from 30-100 km/h. Do not raise peak mu, weaken B=15, add analog speed caps, or retune a coefficient just to improve a subjective number. Diagnose actual normal-path behavior, quantify before/after, and only propose a small behavioral patch when evidence beats the current branch. Any behavior change must include deterministic regression coverage and preserve test:tire, test:cornering, test:conventions, test:tire-feel, test:m5-validation:strict, track QA and build as applicable.

Lane 10 — rear-steer transition shape. The current sweep shows useful opposite-phase low speed, near-zero around 80 km/h, useful same-phase at 100 km/h. Audit exact interpolation around 50-100 km/h for derivative discontinuity or transient sign flip under changing vehicle speed. Build a sweep across every 5 km/h and quantify rear angle/yaw/front slip. Patch only smoothing/hysteresis if the transition itself is measurably abrupt.
